messages:
maria: Quick sync — embedding accelerator vendor (EdgeEmbed Inc.) wants to list in cloud marketplaces next quarter. We need to finalize what evidence we require from them (firmware SBOM, SOC2 cover page, 3rd-party lib attestations) and who owns redaction + presign uploads. TL;DR: who can own presign TTL and witness for pen test?

ajay: I can take presign ownership for the vendor artifacts. Propose 7-day TTL for partner S3 presigns.

lena: For pen test witnessing, SI team wants a 2-week window where they can join remote live test sessions. Are we ok with that? :spiral_calendar:

maria: 2-week window sounds fine. Need to confirm legal embargo and NDA scoping before live witness. Sophie/Legal?

sophie: Legal needs list of endpoints and data classes. Also want attestations for any closed-source binary blobs. We'll require a signed attestation doc (PDF) and hash list.

security-bot: NOTE: previous marketplace listings required: SOC2 Type II summary, recent vuln-scan (30d), pen-test report (with redaction markers), SBOM, KMS/HSM attestation if key material involved.

tom: Actionable items: 1) Ajay -> presign flow + TTL (7d) 2) Lena -> schedule SI witness window + contact SI lead 3) Maria -> ask vendor for firmware SBOM + signed attestation 4) Sophie -> provide NDA scope checklist.

ajay: Presign command we use for partners (example):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgeembed/firmware-v1.bin --expires-in 604800
```

ajay: Will gate on mime-type and a required metadata header `x-partner-id: edgeembed`. I'll put the presign runbook in the shared drive and give write access to lena and maria.

lena: SI lead (Raj) prefers mornings PST. I'll share a doodle and propose 2-week windows around 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-24.

maria: Vendor asked about redaction responsibility for third-party libs in firmware — we should require vendor to provide a pre-redacted artifact plus raw artifact for internal review only. Raw goes to secure S3 with strict ACLs and presign TTLs; only legal + sec + SI will have access.

sophie: Confirming — vendor supplies: pre-redacted PDFs, raw reports uploaded to secure bucket, HSM attestation if keys used, SBOM JSON, and a signed attest.doc. We'll include retention and deletion window in SOW (30 days after listing).

security-bot: REMINDER: mark runner ticket with tag `marketplace-evidence` so we can track RBAC and retention.

tom: I'll create the tracker card and assign owners + deadlines. Proposed deadlines: vendor artifacts due 2026-04-15, pen witness window early May, listing review by 2026-05-31.

maria: Thanks — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they agree to the owners and dates? If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll lock the plan and ping vendor.

ajay: :thumbsup:
lena: :thumbsup:
sophie: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
security-bot: :eyes:
